title: Bus association to march to Secretariat today over vendor relocation row

ai.summary: The Khasi Hills Bazar Bus Association plans a peaceful march to the Secretariat to protest proposed relocation of street vendors to Mawlonghat parking lot, refusing to vacate until government addresses grievances.

facts.claim: The Khasi Hills Bazar Bus Association (KHDBA) will hold a peaceful rally to the Secretariat on Wednesday to protest the proposed relocation of street vendors to the Mawlonghat parking lot
facts.quote: The Khasi Hills Bazar Bus Association (KHDBA) will hold a peaceful rally to the Secretariat on Wednesday to protest the proposed relocation of street vendors to the Mawlonghat parking lot.

facts.claim: The association has hardened its stance, refusing to vacate the facility until the government addresses its grievances
facts.quote: The association has hardened its stance, refusing to vacate the facility until the government addresses its grievances.

facts.claim: Association general secretary Kyrshan Rynjah stated that the decision follows an inconclusive meeting with Director of Urban Affairs PK Boro on Tuesday, where officials reportedly asked for a vacating date instead of discussing the operators’ concerns
facts.quote: Association general secretary Kyrshan Rynjah stated that the decision follows an inconclusive meeting with Director of Urban Affairs PK Boro on Tuesday, where officials reportedly asked for a vacating date instead of discussing the operators’ concerns.

facts.claim: Bus operators have been staging a night-long protest at the parking lot for over a week
facts.quote: Bus operators have been staging a night-long protest at the parking lot for over a week.

facts.claim: The facility is a vital transport hub, catering to buses from five districts and approximately 41 villages
facts.quote: The facility is a vital transport hub, catering to buses from five districts and approximately 41 villages.

facts.claim: The rally is scheduled to begin at Iew Mawlong, proceed through Motphran to the Secretariat and return to the Mawlonghat parking lot
facts.quote: The rally is scheduled to begin at Iew Mawlong, proceed through Motphran to the Secretariat and return to the Mawlonghat parking lot.

facts.claim: The Association has appealed to regular commuters and bus users to join the march in support of their cause
facts.quote: The Association has appealed to regular commuters and bus users to join the march in support of their cause.

ai.background_note: The Khasi Hills Bazar Bus Association is part of the Meghalaya teachers' strike movement, which rejects the state's Centralised Fund Scheme 2026.
